Overfield ਸਵੇਰ ਦੀ ਯੋਜਨਾ, ਖੇਤ F0001, 2026-10-17 ਦੇ ਸੈਟੇਲਾਈਟ ਪਾਸ ਤੋਂ। ਸਥਿਤੀ: ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿਓ.
ਅੱਜ: Crop looks ready and the forecast is dry through 2026-10-30: start as soon as the combine is free.
ਜਾਂਚਾਂ:
- ਵਾਢੀ ਦੀ ਤਿਆਰੀ: ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿਓ. Crop looks ready to harvest: expected 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-19; dry weather through 2026-10-30
- ਮੀਂਹ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਵਾਢੀ: ਠੀਕ. No rain of 15 mm or more in the next 3 days; frost expected on 2026-10-17 (-0.5 °C): the crop is mature, so it will not hurt the grain; no need to rush
- ਫ਼ਸਲ ਦਾ ਜੰਮਣਾ: ਠੀਕ. Crop established: peak NDVI 0.80 on 2026-08-09
- ਸੜਨ ਦਾ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ: ਠੀਕ. No burn or tillage scar
- ਅੱਗ: ਠੀਕ. No hotspot in the last 5 days
- ਖੜ੍ਹਾ ਪਾਣੀ: ਠੀਕ. No standing water in the latest pass (2026-10-17)
- ਤਣਾਅ ਜਾਂ ਪੀਲਾਪਣ: ਠੀਕ. Crop holding steady since 2026-10-10
- ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਤਬਦੀਲੀ: ਠੀਕ. No change since the previous pass (2026-10-10)
ਮੌਸਮ: Combine-ready since 2026-10-17. Dry through 2026-10-30: start as soon as the combine is free. Frost on 2026-10-17 (light frost): the crop is mature, so it will not hurt the grain.
ਅੱਗੇ ਦਾ ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ਾ: Yield estimate: about 45 bushels an acre (40 to 50), low for the zone, from the county model and the greenness curve of this field. Soil and terrain: Loam; typical for the zone. Harvest now or wait: about the same: Beans at about 13% moisture: harvesting now or in a week costs about the same (within $169), so combine when the machine is free. 100% chance to finish the 0.5 machine-days before the next rain, 100% within 7 days. Soil is wet, 2 days since the last real rain. Began browning on 2026-09-02, 30 days before the other soybean fields in Z01 (2026-10-02): early dry-down, disease or drought stress.
ਖ਼ਤਰੇ: Crop looks ready to harvest: expected 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-19; dry weather through 2026-10-30

आज: Nothing needs action today. Harvest, rain, fire, flood and stress were checked and are fine.

- कटाई की तैयारी: ठीक. Looks harvested from the satellite: greenness collapsed around 2026-10-04
- बारिश से पहले कटाई: ठीक. Field is already harvested; rain and frost no longer matter for this crop
- फसल का जमाव: ठीक. Crop established: peak NDVI 0.92 on 2026-07-28
- जलने का निशान: ठीक. No burn or tillage scar
- आग: ठीक. No hotspot in the last 5 days
- खड़ा पानी: ठीक. No standing water in the latest pass (2026-10-17)
- तनाव या पीलापन: ठीक. No standing crop to stress
- दिखने वाला बदलाव: ठीक. No change since the previous pass (2026-10-10)
आगे का अनुमान: Yield estimate: about 206 bushels an acre (175 to 238), high for the zone, from the county model and the greenness curve of this field. Soil and terrain: Clay loam; typical for the zone. Soil is wet, 2 days since the last real rain.
